title: Things to Do Before You Study

source.name: VOA Learning English — Things to Do Before You Study
source.license: Nội dung của VOA (Voice of America), phạm vi công cộng
source.note: Đã rút gọn: chỉ giữ một số đoạn.

paras: Many students think about how to best spend their time while studying. But what comes before study sessions can be important too - especially if you want to improve your memory of what you have learned.
Three important ideas to think about before studying include exercise, study location and pre-study tests. Let’s look at each of these in turn.
Before you study, doing cardiovascular exercise may help you better remember what you learn. High-intensity exercise may be especially helpful.
In a 2018 study, published in the journal Physiology and Behavior , researchers found that a group of young people who did 15 minutes of high-intensity training on a treadmill remembered more words.

Location is also important for improving your learning. While it is good to have a desk or a special study area, some research suggests that changing where you study could help you remember more of what you study.
Our memories sometimes depend on things in our environment. For example, a book might remind you of something interesting or strange you learned while reading it.

Be sure to plan your location before you start to study. You might want to try studying in different places. Perhaps one day you could study in your room, and then the next day you could study in the kitchen, or outside. You do not have to change locations every day, but try to at least sometimes.
We have talked about exercise and location. Now let’s talk about a third way you can improve your study session: taking a pre-study test.
But, students need to test themselves often. Testing is one of the best ways to make yourself remember new information.

In 2018, researchers found that students who took a test before learning new material did much better after studying the material. The research was published in the Journal of Experimental Psychology .
The students failed on the tests, but they were better able to remember the material than students who were only asked to read the information.
So, try to take a pre-study test. If you are using a textbook, you might want to look to the end of the chapter and do a few practice questions before you read it.

questions.q: What is the main idea of the text?
options: Students should always work in the same quiet room to learn well
Tests are only useful after the whole course has been completed
The longer students study each day, the more they will remember
Some things done before studying can help students remember more
questions.explain: Đoạn 1–2: những việc làm TRƯỚC khi học (exercise, location, pre-study tests) giúp nhớ lâu hơn. Các đáp án khác sai hoặc ngược với bài (đổi chỗ học có thể tốt hơn; kiểm tra trước khi học có ích).

questions.q: What did the 2018 treadmill study find?
options: A short burst of hard exercise went together with better memory for words
Exercise made no difference to how well people remembered
Young people who ran outdoors learned fewer words than those indoors
An hour of gentle walking improved the results of young people
questions.explain: Đoạn 4: nhóm tập “15 minutes of high-intensity training” nhớ nhiều từ hơn ≈ tập ngắn, cường độ cao → nhớ từ tốt hơn.

questions.q: Why might it help to study in several different places?
options: A desk makes people feel too tired to concentrate
Moving between rooms counts as extra exercise
Teachers usually give better marks for varied study places
Things around you can act as reminders of what you learned
questions.explain: Đoạn 6: trí nhớ đôi khi phụ thuộc vào những thứ trong môi trường (“a book might remind you of something…”) ≈ mọi thứ xung quanh làm gợi nhớ.

questions.q: What is surprising about the research on pre-study tests?
options: Students who passed the early test learned nothing new during the later lesson
Students found the early test much easier than the final test they took later
Students who did badly on the early test still learned better than those who only read the material
Students who read the text twice scored higher than the students who were tested
questions.explain: Đoạn 11: học sinh “failed on the tests” nhưng nhớ tài liệu tốt hơn nhóm chỉ đọc → điều bất ngờ là làm sai bài kiểm tra trước vẫn có lợi.

questions.q: What does the writer advise if you are using a textbook?
options: Skip the practice questions so that there is more time for reading
Read each chapter twice and only then try to answer any questions
Do some of the questions at the end of a chapter before reading it
Ask a friend to read the chapter aloud to you before you begin
questions.explain: Đoạn 12: “look to the end of the chapter and do a few practice questions before you read it”.

questions.q: The writer says that having a special study area is a bad idea.
questions.explain: Đoạn 5: “it is good to have a desk or a special study area”; chỉ thêm rằng đổi chỗ đôi khi cũng giúp nhớ hơn.

questions.q: More than one hundred young people took part in the treadmill study.
questions.explain: Bài không nêu số người tham gia nghiên cứu (đoạn 4 chỉ nói “a group of young people”).
